prompt: write a very long, detailed description of the 20th century in the style of the bible, use biblical language. Part 1, The brothers of the descendants of Wright and the Great War
judge_reasoning: Candidate 2 most strongly matches the prompt by delivering the longest, most detailed biblical-style account and by making the “brothers” (Jacob and Esau) central to the Great War narrative and its resolution. Candidate 4 is also very strong—consistently biblical in tone and with a clear WWI timeline (1903, 1914, 1917, 1918)—but it emphasizes the Wright invention and war events more than the brothers-of-the-descendants storyline. Candidate 3 is coherent and suitably biblical, though narrower in scope and less expansive over the wider arc of the 20th century. Candidate 1 is the least detailed/complete, with a comparatively abbreviated treatment of the century and the Great War’s aftermath.
